description: This header file defines C and C++ replacements for sscanf, specifically SscanfWithCLocale, to parse strings in a locale-independent manner. It is intended for parsing input data from fixed protocols rather than user input, supporting floating point number parsing.

classes.description: Namespace encapsulating the C++ template overload for SscanfWithCLocale.

methods.description: A function that parses a string according to a format string in a locale-independent manner, supporting variadic arguments.
